relics.name: Fateweaver's Sigil
relics.trigger: After drawing own three magical hand cards and before any opening magic window; only if at least one additional magical draw source is available.
relics.effect: Choose exactly one of the three drawn magic cards, put it on bottom of spell draw pile; draw exactly one replacement from top. If draw is empty before placement, discard pile may be reshuffled using normal spell-deck rule, then chosen card goes to bottom. No Aether, Lifechips or cast consumed. No physical poker card affected.
relics.public_tell: The Sigil briefly rearranges a spell.

weights: Base reward 60% common / 35% uncommon / 5% rare; renormalize when unavailable; no forced rare if already owned; non-owned filter before weight renormalization.
